title: Normalized units presentation of an algebraic-space Picard obstruction
statement:
Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $j:Z\to Z'$ a morphism of algebraic spaces with their small etale ringed sites [def-trf-algebraic-space], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Use the normalized thickening site model of [def-sfb-space-square-zero-extension-data] and the small affine etale ringed model and module restriction equivalence of [def-sfb-space-small-ringed-model]. Module sheaves are [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Write $H^n_{\rm Mod}(Z,M)=\operatorname{Ext}^n_{\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_Z)}(\mathcal O_Z,M)$ on this small model; applying $\operatorname{Hom}(\mathcal O_Z,-)$ to an injective module resolution identifies this with right derived global sections. Write $A_{ab}$ for the additive sheaf of a commutative-ring sheaf $A$. For a ring-sheaf map $p:A\to B$, write $p^\times:A^\times\to B^\times$ for restriction on units and $Q(p)=(\ker p^\times\to A^\times\to B^\times)$ for its categorical kernel sequence. Units are written additively as in [def-sfb-ringed-site-picard-data], and their cohomology is [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology].

A normalized Picard units presentation for $j$ consists of: a normalized thickening site model $T$; a commutative ring sheaf $A$ on the reduced small affine model; an isomorphism of its underlying ring presheaf with the restriction of $T$'s transported thick ring; a quotient $p:A\to\mathcal O_Z$ which under that isomorphism is exactly the pullback of regular functions along the reduction arrows of $T$; a quasi-coherent module $J$ on the original small etale site [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module]; and an additive map $i:J_{ab}\to A_{ab}$ after restriction to the affine model. Require $i$ injective on each object, its image equal to $\ker p$ on each object, and $p$ locally surjective on covering sieves. Require $i(m)i(n)=0$ and $i(p(a)m)=a i(m)$ on each object. Include a proof that $Q(p)$ is short exact and an isomorphism $e:J_{ab}\cong\ker p^\times$ normalized by the equation that its composite with the kernel inclusion sends $m$ to the unit $1+i(m)$. Include a map $z:\underline{\mathbf Z}\to(\mathcal O_Z)_{ab}$ sending the distinguished section $1$ to the actual ring section $1$ on each object. No existence of a presentation is part of this definition.

For such a presentation define the canonical module-to-abelian cohomology homomorphism $H^n_{\rm Mod}(Z,J)\to H^n(Z,J_{ab})$ by applying the exact forgetful functor from module sheaves to abelian sheaves to an Ext class and then precomposing with $z$. No inverse or bijectivity is asserted in this definition.
